the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Argue by Noetherian induction on the base, glue along irreducible components and the closures of their complements where the induction hypothesis applies to both pieces and the disjoint union of the two completely decomposed proper covers is again completely decomposed with the flat subschemes viewed as subschemes of the combined pullback, then in the integral case write the generic fibre of the cycle as a combination of prime cycles, take closures in X, apply generic flatness to obtain an open of the base over which the closures are flat, use the blowing-up lemma for flatness to find an admissible blowing up on which the strict transforms are flat over the new base, and recognize the resulting family of cycle classes as the pullback by the uniqueness lemma for extensions agreeing at the generic point, finally repair the fact that the blowing up need not be completely decomposed by Noetherian induction on the complement of the open and taking the disjoint union of the two covers (source lines 1186-1231)
